page_title: GEN 1-4 FIO | Genoa v Fiorentina 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity!
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
88' A substitution has been made. Giacomo Bonaventura is replaced by Gino Infantino (Fiorentina).
87' Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
87' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is penalised for holding. Giovanni Ayroldi signals a set piece.
84' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his header from near the penalty spot towards the bottom of the right post is saved by the goalkeeper.
83' The corner is swung in but Genoa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' M'Bala Nzola goes off the pitch and Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) comes on.
81' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Rolando Mandragora is replaced by Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina).
81' We are about to witness a subsitution. Dodo (Fiorentina) for Michael Kayode.
81' The game is interrupted. Morten Frendrup (Genoa) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
80' Mattia Bani (Genoa) has tested the patience of referee Giovanni Ayroldi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
79' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
77' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Fiorentina win a corner.
76' Fiorentina quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
75' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
72' It will be a substitution. Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) is ready to enter the pitch as Nicolas Gonzalez walks off.
72' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
67' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul.
65' 28:72 – the ratio of ball possession.
61' Fiorentina failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
59' We are about to witness a substitution. Johan Vasquez (Genoa) is replacing Silvan Hefti.
59' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Aaron Martin and he is replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
59' The game has come to an end for Milan Badelj. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Filip Jagiello (Genoa).
58' 1 - 4 Davide Biraschi (Genoa) reacts quickly in the penalty area and scores with aplomb, giving the goalkeeper no chance!
58' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Genoa comes to nothing.

56' 0 - 4 Goooooal! Giacomo Bonaventura beats his man and slings in a cross towards Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina), who evades his marker and plants a fine header inside the left post from close in. 0:4.
52' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fiorentina.

52' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
51' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
49' The Fiorentina players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

40' 0 - 3 A perfectly taken corner kick. Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the bottom right corner, increasing the score of today's match – 0:3.
40' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
39' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
36' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
35' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Josep Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
34' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giovanni Ayroldi had an easy-decision to make.
32' The free kick from long range, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
32' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Genoa in a dangerous position.
29' Josip Brekalo (Fiorentina) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) is flagged for offside.
26' A cooling break is underway.
24' Flag up against Mattia Bani (Genoa). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
24' The free kick from long range, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
22' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
21' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Mateo Retegui (Genoa) for his blatant foul.
17' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
15' The referee blows his whistle as M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in his challenge.
13' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle. Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) commits a foul after dangerous play.
11' 0 - 2 Goal! Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 0:2.
11' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Josep Martinez easily deals with the threat.
9' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

5' 0 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the top left corner and makes it 0:1. Josep Martinez was helpless.
4' Genoa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
3' Josip Brekalo (Fiorentina) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
2' The free kick from long range, taken by Fiorentina, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Radu Dragusin (Genoa) was too forceful with his tackle and Giovanni Ayroldi interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Fiorentina have a free kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Fiorentina will kick the game off.
Giovanni Ayroldi will officiate today.
